title: Semi-matte
identify: Can resemble satin under certain lighting.
recognition: Mostly matte appearance, with weak reflections at some viewing angles.

confused_with.difference: Satin, semi-matte and satin-matte overlap considerably; one photo may not separate them.
Matte: little or no sharp reflection at any angle.
